status: Unchanged M1A fixed values; M1B accounting proposal, not implemented
rules: All caps apply simultaneously, with no public override or per-pack reset.
Inflated charges codec-produced bytes plus delta reconstructed bytes, including discarded duplicates.
Object cap independently applies to raw direct body, delta program and reconstructed body.
Resident reserves precede allocation and include concurrently live owners and index metadata.
Byte scans, checksums, copies, comparisons and delta instructions charge work before performing it.
Explicit work checkpoints at most4096 units apart preserve the M1A cooperative profile, not native preemption.
Releasing owners refunds resident occupancy only, never read/inflate/work or intrinsic delta depth.
Count physical pack entries for verification/entry work; count deduplicated object names separately.
Root direct object delta depth0; each delta edge adds1 even when its base is already cached.
Provider allocations, JS overhead and native zlib allocations are not an exact process-RSS bound.
